# Scanlark

> Privacy-first, on-device OCR and QR generation application.
> Architected and developed by Krish Ujeniya (@krishujeniya).
> Developer Profile: https://github.com/krishujeniya
> Portfolio Showcase: https://mostlyoutlier.pages.dev/
> Live Site: https://scanlark.pages.dev/
> Source Repository: https://github.com/krishujeniya/Scanlark

## Overview
Scanlark is an open-source Flutter mobile and web application engineered for rapid image-to-text optical character recognition (OCR), local scan history management, and QR code generation. All computer vision and OCR pipelines execute completely on-device without cloud egress or image upload requirements.

## Author & Ecosystem
- Author: Krish Ujeniya (https://github.com/krishujeniya)
- Canonical Person Entity: https://krishujeniya.dev/#krishujeniya
- Linked Projects: AGYOS, Hadron, WaferPulse, Somnostasis, Curavex, Hajree, TraceMigo

## Technical Specifications
- Engine: Google ML Kit On-Device Text Recognition
- Framework: Flutter (Dart) with multi-platform targets (Android, Web)
- Privacy Standard: Local-first offline processing with zero telemetry or data retention
- Storage: Local Hive SQLite encrypted key-value store for scan history
